translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Med'inaa Goday Iyyooba,
«Iyyoobaa, Asay Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossaanna mootettiide, shatimmi erii? Ane S'oossaanna mootettiyaa uray aw zaaro» yaageedda.
Iyyooba Zaaruwaa
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Iyyoobi Med'inaa Godaw zaariide, hawaadan yaageedda;
«Abeet S'oossaw, taani patsenna laafa asaa; taani new woota zaaranaw danddayayitaa? Taani ta doonaan ta kushiyaa wotsaad.
Taani itti gede haasayaad; shin taw zaariyaawe baawa. Laa"entsuwaa haasayikke» yaageedda.
S'oossay K'aykka Haasayee
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, Med'inaa Goday gotiyaa giddoppe Iyyoobaw hawaadan yaageedda;
«Attuma asaadan ne s'eessaa danc'c'a denddaade, taani oochchiyaawaa taw oda.
Neeni taana bayzzanchcha kessana hanay? New s'illuwaa gidanaw, taana wordduwaa kessay?
S'oossaa wolk'k'aa mala wolk'k'ay new de'ii? S'oossay guummiyaawaadan neeni guummanaw danddayay?
Hewaa gidooppe, ane ne bonchchuwaaninne gitatetsan dendda! Ne puulaanne anggaa mayya!
Ne hank'k'uwaa boshaa ane tiga; otorettiyaa asaa ubbaa s'eellaade, ane kawushsha!
Ane loytsa s'eellaade, otorettiyaa ubbaa yeellaya; iitaa ootsiyaawantta ubbaa unttunttu de'iyaa saan yed'd'a!
Unttunttu ubbaa biittan mooga; duufuwaa duge wotsaade, unttuntta gordda.
Yaatooppe, ne wolk'k'an neeni s'oonanawaa taani new markkattana.
«Taani neena med'd'eeddawaadan med'd'eedda, Bihemoota giyaa do'aa ane s'eella! I booraadan maataa mee.
Aa s'eessan de'iyaa wolk'k'aynne Aa uluwaa kammeedda shayaa minotetsay loytsi daro.
Aa dufii zigaadan sitti gi utteedda; Aa gediyaa s'ap'otuukka minuwaan dook'eteeddawantta.
Aa mek'etsatuu naasiyaa bombbaa mala; Aa gediikka birataa zanggetuwaa mala.
«S'oossay med'd'eedda med'etatuu ubbaappe I aad'd'i malalissiyaawaa. Aa Med'd'eeddawaappe attina, Aa s'oonanaw danddayiyaawe baawa.
Do'ay ubbay kaa'iyaa zoozii aw miyaawaa mokissee.
Aguntsay de'iyaa mitsaa garssan gisee; mak'k'aa giddon c'ariyaan k'osettee.
Aguntsay de'iyaa mitsatuu barenttu kuwan Aa gentsiino; shaafaa doonaan doliyaa mitsatuu Aa kammiino.
Shaafay kumiide goggiyaa wodekka dagammenna; Yorddaanoosa Shaafay Aa som"uwaan d'arc'c'ettiyaa wodekka I saro de'ee.
Aa ayifiyaa toyissiide, Aa oyk'k'anaw danddayiyaa Asay de'ii? Aa siid'iyaakka p'iriyaa k'aran c'addi oyk'k'anaw danddayiyaawe oonee?
